wording_corrections.old: Teach inspection before modelling in two 45-minute sessions. Use fictional data only. Emphasize the unit of observation, provenance, units, unknown values and overlapping audit flags. The dataset card is a concise classroom documentation exercise inspired by datasheets for datasets, not a claim to implement every part of a research framework. Students must distinguish observations from unsupported repairs and from evidence of model fitness.
wording_corrections.new: Use the full three-session route to compare an intended-use statement with complete fictional sample manifests. Teach condition counts and distinct plant IDs separately. Prior trip-inspection examples remain optional review. No model is fitted and no accuracy result is supplied.

wording_corrections.new: Use four condition cards and separate counters for photos and distinct source plants. Offer blank coverage headings rather than completed counts. Extend by asking which label, species and sampling-frequency dimensions the manifests do not establish.

Do not infer whether the two N rows describe one event without checking the source.
wording_corrections.new: Selected independent plan should cover outdoor lighting and new devices with documented sources/labels and shared plant IDs, separate development collection from fresh evaluation, and report per-slice limits without invented accuracy. Fresh retry: training only mature plants in daylight camera A; intended use seedlings under evening camera B. Require a condition-specific collection/evaluation plan and the distinction between unknown performance and proved failure.
